{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Red Devil Squadron''''' was a small [[Squadron/Legends|Squadron]] of 3 [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defenders]] built by [[Nami]] [[Crime lord/Legends|Crime Lord]] [[Ali Tarrak]]. After discovering Tarrak's [[Deep Space Manufacturing Facility]] where she was building [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defenders]]. Then, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] launched an [[Capture of Ali Tarrak|assault]] to put an end to her attempt to proliferate the TIE Defenders. After her original fighter defenses were destroyed both squadrons were dispatched, likely before their shields were fully charged, to attack the [[Missile Boat]] piloted by [[Tan (title)|Tan]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]], while [[Blue Devil Squadron]] would attack [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial-class Star Destroyer]] [[Grey Wolf]]. Both TIE Defender squadrons were destroyed in the battle.
